    def maximizeSquareHoleArea(self, n: int, m: int, hBars: List[int], vBars: List[int]) -> int:
        hmax = 1
        gmax = 1
        i = 0
        
        # Sort hBars
        hBars.sort()
        
        # Sort vBars
        vBars.sort()
        
        # Initialize prev for horizontal bars
        prev = hBars[0]
        
        # Process horizontal bars
        while i < len(hBars):
            diff = hBars[i] - 1 != hBars[i - 1] if i > 0 else True
            if diff:
                hmax = max(hmax, hBars[i - 1] - prev + 2)
            prev = hBars[i]
            i += 1
        
        # Update hmax for the last segment
        hmax = max(hmax, hBars[-1] - prev + 2)
        
        # Initialize prev for vertical bars
        prev = vBars[0]
        i = 0
        
        # Process vertical bars
        while i < len(vBars):
            diff = vBars[i] - 1 != vBars[i - 1] if i > 0 else True
            if diff:
                gmax = max(gmax, vBars[i - 1] - prev + 2)
            prev = vBars[i]
            i += 1
        
        # Update gmax for the last segment
        gmax = max(gmax, vBars[-1] - prev + 2)
